entries.rationale: The expected dictionary is consumed as a whole by registry == expected in validate_envelope. The detector only tracks individual subscript reads and misclassifies this aggregate comparison. Strict registry mutation tests cover the comparison.

entries.rationale: The four flagged lines define named MAX_MANIFEST_BYTES, MAX_RESULT_BYTES, MAX_EXECUTION_BYTES and MAX_ENVELOPE_BYTES constants. The 1024 factors express 1 MiB, 8 MiB, 64 KiB and 4 MiB limits; they are explicit bounded-input policy constants rather than unexplained values scattered through logic. Byte-limit rejection tests exercise their use.
